manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the right arm to move the soft bread with golden edges into the medium light brown breadbasket.

Task description: Use the right arm to place the soft bread with golden edges on the right side of the view into the medium shallow brown woven bread basket in front.

Success criteria: All bread in the scene must be inside the basket, each piece horizontally near the basket body and above the table, with both grippers open. Placing only the designated piece while other bread remains outside does not count.

## Execution tips

- Grip flatter, thick middle sections of opposite bread sides, opening slightly wider than local width. Confirm the fingers surround it before closing moderately to reduce drops from gripping thin edges or corners.
- During transport, keep the bread base and fingertips high enough to clear the basket rim, avoiding contact that could shift the basket or drop the bread.
- If bread is already inside the basket, offset the landing point slightly and avoid the rim to reduce mutual pushing. Release once supported by the basket bottom or existing bread to reduce rolling out after a drop.
